verdicts.human_summary: The reset action is always wired for every inline canvas with no opt-out mechanism. It should be gated behind a configurable prop or docs parameter so consumers can opt out per-story, per-component, or globally.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment addresses the configurability/opt-out concern. AI comments cover event type correctness (Comment 0), race conditions between reset mechanisms (Comment 1), type organization (Comment 2), icon choice (Comment 3), missing tests (Comment 4), and terminology inconsistency (Comment 5) — none of which relate to making the reset button configurable or optional.
